input.change_text: Security: on macOS, `/private/{etc,var,tmp,home}` paths are now treated as dangerous removal targets under `Bash(rm:*)` allow rules

output.subject: macOS /private symlink paths now dangerous under Bash(rm:*) rules
output.action_text: Upgrade macOS `claude-code` hosts to 2.1.113+ to treat `/private/{etc,var,tmp,home}` as dangerous removal targets under `Bash(rm:*)` allow rules. Pre-fix, macOS-specific symlink layout let `rm /private/etc/X` evade rules expecting the canonical `/etc/X` path.
